scope: Human menopause stage/FMP, ovulation/fertile window, wearable temperature/HR/HRV/sleep; primary repositories and original studies. A broad search, not a guarantee that every dataset in existence was found.

access_definitions.public_catalog: Repository metadata inspected; data not acquired
access_definitions.unavailable: No usable public raw files at checked endpoint
access_definitions.quarantine: Provenance, licensing or label validity unresolved

sources.title: Assaf et al Jordan menopause QoL
sources.risk: one duplicate, ambiguous numeric codes, QOL3levels versus questionnaire5levels, cause-field contradiction; no longitudinal/ring measurements

sources.title: NHANES2015-2016
sources.labels: current self-reported natural menopause versus menstruating within12months
sources.risk: cross-sectional, not ring, surgical/current-hormone exclusions incomplete; no FMP forecast

sources.title: NHANES2017-2018
sources.risk: same study system; not independent-device or prospective validation

sources.title: Monitoring female fertile ground
sources.risk: event-aligned timestamps; full-cycle normalization; bidirectional imputation upstream; no anovulatory negatives; infer identity by ID prefix

sources.title: mcPHASES
sources.license: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data License1.5.0, registration+DUA advertised
sources.role: best named multimodal fertility candidate if original access restored
sources.risk: checked version and root page explicitly say files no longer available; latest DOI did not yield usable files; NOT downloaded; hormone-label inputs must be excluded from X

sources.title: SWAN public-use ICPSR archive
sources.modality: longitudinal bleeding, stage, hormones, symptoms and covariates
sources.role: main candidate to develop future-menopause model
sources.risk: check release variables, visit dates, missingness and censoring; no equivalent continuous Oura signals; not downloaded

sources.title: SWAN NIA AgingResearchBiobank
sources.role: longitudinal event-time development and targeted sleep/VMS research
sources.risk: same underlying SWAN cohort as ICPSR; never count as independent validation; application required

sources.title: Maijala et al2019 nocturnal finger temperature
sources.license: open paper does not imply open participant data
sources.risk: no downloadable raw participant file verified

sources.title: Alzueta et al2022 Tracking Sleep Temperature Heart Rate and Daily Symptoms
sources.risk: no verified open raw archive; no future menopause endpoint

sources.title: Using wearable skin temperature data to advance tracking and characterization of the menstrual cycle
sources.risk: public paper only; no verified raw data download

sources.title: Menstrual Cycle Variations in Wearable-detected Finger Temperature and Heart Rate but not Sleep Metrics
sources.role: age/stage transportability; do not assume every sleep measure is a cycle biomarker
sources.risk: study associations are not prospective menopause prediction; no raw archive verified

sources.title: Oura Ring as a Tool for Ovulation Detection Validation Analysis
sources.risk: raw data and proprietary algorithm unavailable; publication contains participant-count inconsistencies;96.4% is detection rate, not prospective fertile-window accuracy

sources.title: Oura Clue UC Berkeley perimenopause study
sources.role: potential future collaboration and cohort design
sources.risk: announcement is not an externally validated menopause prediction model

sources.title: NICHD BioCycle
sources.modality: repeated reproductive hormones and cycle data
sources.risk: not a smart-ring dataset; approved data request needed

sources.title: UK Biobank female reproductive history and accelerometry
sources.license: approved researcher application and UKB terms/costs
sources.role: large-scale age/context external validation; motion representation
sources.risk: not unrestricted open data; accelerometry not same nightly ring temperature; timing of measurements must match target

sources.title: Detecting variations in ovulation and menstruation during COVID19
sources.role: cycle-timing population prior and shift research
sources.risk: data availability stated by original article; file endpoint not successfully inspected here; no ring signals; not acquired

sources.title: IFH Affect longitudinal Oura and Samsung data
sources.license: verify Dryad download license; code release separate
sources.role: unlabelled Oura preprocessing and negative-confound testing
sources.risk: no validated reproductive endpoint identified; code-only Zenodo mirror is not the8.59GB data; no supervised fertility/menopause training

sources.title: LEMURS differentially private synthetic survey release
sources.modality: DPsynthetic behavioral survey; original cohort woreOura
sources.risk: released file is synthetic survey data; must not call it rawOura signals or reproductive validation

sources.title: LifeSnaps
sources.risk: no verified hormone/FMP labels; device domain gap; not a source for supervised menopause labels

sources.title: Menopausal study with MEG
sources.risk: MEG is not ring input; do not transfer modality-specific predictive claims

sources.title: Perimenopause and emergence of Alzheimers bioenergetic phenotype
sources.role: small independently defined stage cohort for background
sources.risk: verify whether files are individual-level versus supplementary tables; no ring signals; not acquired

sources.title: Climacteric Womens Perspectives on Menopause and Hormone Therapy
sources.risk: repository endpoint did not open; underlying rows and license unverified; not used

sources.title: MachineLearning Prediction for Menopause Women with Low BoneMass
sources.risk: target is low bone mass in menopausal women, not predicting menopause or fertile window; no ring measurements

sources.title: HuggingFace haammar fem-state CycleBench
sources.license: card saysOpenRAIL; original participant-data rights unverified
sources.role: do not train until original provenance, consent, groups and labels verified
sources.risk: range anomalies(sleep4778min,steps3.86million,temp-8.13C); resembles derivatives of restricted health data; card license alone insufficient

sources.title: Menstrual cycle through the lens of a wearable device
sources.license: code repository is not participant-data license
sources.risk: this study is WHOOP, notOura; no raw data acquired; do not mix validation claims

sources.title: WearableSensors Reveal MensesDrivenChanges and Enable Prediction of FertileWindow
sources.risk: manufacturer-associated study; nonOura device; evaluation target differs from retrospective thermal-rise detection

sources.title: UCI Fertility dataset
sources.risk: male fertility classification is unrelated to female ovulation or menopause
